# Sequenzy

Sequenzy is an email marketing and automation platform for managing subscribers, campaigns, sequences, transactional email, analytics, and related workspace resources.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sequenzy/.

## Actions

- **Create Tag**: Create a reusable subscriber tag definition.
- **Delete Tag**: Permanently delete a non-system tag definition and remove it from every subscriber.
- **Get Email Metrics** (read-only): Return workspace-wide email delivery and engagement totals and rates for a sliding window or custom range, optionally filtered by email…
- **Get Subscriber** (read-only): Retrieve one subscriber by email with list memberships, sequence enrollments, notes, engagement totals, and recent activity.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): Discover campaigns in the connected workspace, optionally filtered by delivery status or label, without scheduling or sending them.
- **List Sequences** (read-only): Discover automation sequences and inspect whether they accept new enrollments or process existing ones, without activating or enrolling…
- **List Subscriber Lists** (read-only): Return the reusable subscriber lists available for audience filtering and membership workflows.
- **List Subscribers** (read-only): Search and filter subscribers in the connected workspace, returning one stable cursor page for audience review or export.
- **List Tags** (read-only): Return reusable subscriber tag definitions, including which tags are protected system tags.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Discover reusable email templates and campaign-backed email bodies by label, returning one page with localization metadata.
